name: root-cause-before-fix
body: Root-cause the lock race before choosing a fix. The failure must be reproduced deterministically (N concurrent `apg node|edge` mutations against one worktree DB) and the exact failing DB open identified — read-only (`SystemConfig::default().read_only(true)`, `apg.cmd_query`, src/main.rs:963) vs read-write (`SystemConfig::default()`, `apg.artifacts.ArtifactDb.open`, `apg.artifacts.code_universes`, `apg.artifacts.reingest_layers`, `apg.git.reanchor_scan_meta`) — together with why the purpose-built `flock` (`apg.artifacts.acquire_spec_lock` on `apg/.trans/specs.lock`, src/artifacts.rs:25-52) does not serialize it. Acceptance: a written finding names the offending open site(s) and the precise reason the existing flock fails to cover the node/edge mutation path; the fix choice must cite this finding, not assume it.
